sources.entry: poetry - Python dependency management and packaging made easy.

summary.one_liner: Poetry is a Python tool for declaring, managing, installing and packaging project dependencies using a single pyproject.toml file.
summary.what_it_does: Poetry helps declare, manage and install dependencies of Python projects, and it aims to replace setup.py, requirements.txt, setup.cfg, MANIFEST.in and Pipfile with a pyproject.toml-based project format. The README shows a pyproject.toml example with build-system, authors, keywords and dependencies sections, including caret-style version constraints such as ^3.8.1. It points to a simple install script and full installation documentation. Related projects named in the README include poetry-core (a PEP 517 build backend), poetry-plugin-export (export to requirements.txt and similar formats), and poetry-plugin-bundle (install to external formats such as virtual environments). Documentation for current, development and recently unsupported versions is hosted on the official website.
use_cases: replace requirements.txt and setup.py with pyproject.toml
package a Python project for publishing
create virtual environments for a project
lock dependency versions for reproducible installs
how_to_run: Install with the official script at install.python-poetry.org (see the full installation documentation for alternatives)
notable: Single pyproject.toml replaces several legacy packaging files
Plugin ecosystem including export and bundle plugins
Separate poetry-core build backend for PEP 517 builds
caveats: README excerpt is partial; some sections and examples are truncated in the provided text
Contributor-focused project, with a suggested-issues list for newcomers
